title: Legacy SDK JSONMode compatibility and transformation tests
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build a targeted test harness and regression suite to validate compatibility behaviors between legacy SDKs (v1.x) and the current JSONMode/constrained-decoder runtime. Many customers still use older SDKs which emit slightly different wire formats (stream framing, partial-object fragments, legacy tool call envelopes). This ticket defines tests, transformation shims, and expected behavioral reconciliation rules that the compatibility layer must satisfy so that hosted models using streaming, tool/function calls, and structured outputs remain operational without forcing immediate client upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility shim correctly normalizes at least 10 representative legacy output variants into canonical JSONMode stream framing without dropping tool/function call events
End-to-end fuzz runs (1000 randomized samples) produce <=0.1% unrepairable outputs (cases requiring model fallback) and those failures are triaged and documented
Regression harness runs in CI detect at least three existing incompatibility classes: single-quote keys, trailing-comma arrays, and chunked-root-splitting across stream boundaries
Compatibility layer exposes a deterministic mapping log for each normalized message (linkable to logs/dashboard) for debugging customer incidents
Tests include explicit cases for interleaved tool call tokens and validate that tool call start/finish markers are preserved and routed to downstream sinks
test_plan: Inventory: gather 20 real-world legacy payloads from Support/Prod traces (anonymize) covering SDK versions v1.2.0 through v1.9.9

Normalization rules: specify canonical transformations (single->double quotes, remove trailing commas, wrap bare fragments into root object, map legacy 'response'->'output' key, convert legacy tool envelope to standard tool call schema)
Unit tests: implement 50 unit-level tests exercising each rule and combinations (e.g., chunked fragments + legacy envelopes)
Streaming integration: run harness with a mock runtime that emits chunk order permutations and interleaving of tool calls; assert reconstruction correctness and KV cache continuity
Fuzzing: run mutation-based fuzz for 72 hours with stochastic corruptions (byte flips, dropped chunks, reordered chunks) and measure repair success-rate
CI integration: add lightweight smoke suite to PR checks and full fuzz/long-run as nightly job; surface failures to console-structured-output dashboard
comments: 2025-02-19 Aisha Kumar: Kickoff meeting notes — aligned with Support to pull 20 anonymized payload samples. Agreed to prioritize tool-call preservation over silent heuristics that could drop events.

2025-02-25 Emily Zhao (QA): Unit test suite added (25 cases). Found edge case: chunked root object split between two stream frames with a partial UTF-8 sequence — added UTF-8 safe reassembly test.

2025-02-27 Platform SRE: Noted that compatibility normalization adds ~0.6ms median latency on path; agreed acceptable for P1 but we should gate via feature flag for Dedicated customers with strict SLOs.

2025-03-01 Design review (DevExp): Suggested exposing a diagnostic header 'X-Compat-Transform' that lists applied rules per message. Helps customers debug without leaking payloads. Added to acceptance criteria.

2025-03-03 Luca Moretti: Fuzz run (12h) summary — 0.32% failures; majority due to intentionally malformed multi-root streams which we elect to mark unrepairable and surface to customer with clear error. Preparing detailed failure taxonomy.
2025-03-04 Aisha Kumar: Ready for review — PR up for compatibility shim with tests and CI hooks. Requesting review from Runtime and SDK teams before merging. Plan to run full 72h fuzz after approval.
